headline: GFL Limited receives certified NCLT order for its scheme of arrangement
summary: GFL Limited announced that it has received the certified true copy of the final NCLT order regarding its scheme of arrangement, following a hearing held on September 28, 2026. The appointed date for the scheme is set for April 1, 2026. Retail shareholders should note this procedural milestone as the corporate restructuring moves forward.
why_it_matters: Corporate restructuring advances for GFL Limited shareholders.
